Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
    • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
    Safety and Security
    • Night vision - Lift the veil of darkness. We've all been there, it's dark, and suddenly something appears out of nowhere in the road! With this safety feature, the night no longer holds unpleasant surprises. Working in combination with the headlights, night vision uses infrared technology to detect obstacles in the dark and show them on your display screen. Night vision makes for a safer drive between dusk and dawn.
    • Forward Collision and Cross Traffic Mitigation - Forward thinking with a side of safety. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Or a vehicle runs a red light as you're approaching the intersection. That's when the Forward Collision and Cross Traffic Mitigation system comes to life. --When it senses an impending impact in front of you or on either side, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward Collision and Cross Traffic Mitigation is your doting eyes for crossing tees.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

The Range Rover SE PHEV stands as a beacon of modern design and refinement, its Santorini Black finish not just a color, but a statement of sophistication and presence. Adorned with striking 22-inch Style 1073 Gloss Black wheels, Shadow Pack accents, Black Brake Calipers, and Land Rover's unmistakable silhouette, it presents a commanding stance that blends contemporary elegance with legendary capability.

Step inside and the Deep Garnet perforated Semi-Aniline leather interior greets you, exuding an atmosphere of luxury and craftsmanship that only Range Rover can deliver. The 24-way heated and cooled massage front seats with power recline provide exceptional comfort, while the Ebony Headlining and Natural Black Birch veneer elevate the cabin with bespoke detailing and timeless elegance.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this sophisticated SUV is a 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-six Plug-In Hybrid powertrain, unleashing an impressive 542 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a seamlessly engineered 8-speed automatic transmission and Land Rover's advanced All-Wheel Drive system, this powertrain delivers effortless acceleration, remarkable efficiency, and exceptional capability in virtually any driving environment.

Key Features:

• 24-Way Heated and Cooled Massage Front Seats: Offering first-class comfort with power recline, ventilation, heating, and massage functionality for both driver and passenger.

• Deep Garnet Perforated Semi-Aniline Leather Interior: Crafted from premium materials, creating an elegant and luxurious cabin experience.

• Shadow Pack: Enhancing the exterior with sophisticated darkened accents that complement the Santorini Black finish.

• Head-Up Display: Projects critical driving information directly into the driver's field of vision, enhancing safety and convenience.

• 22-inch Style 1073 Gloss Black Wheels: Providing a bold and commanding presence while complementing the vehicle's premium design.

• Meridian 3D Surround Sound System: Delivering an immersive listening experience with exceptional clarity and depth throughout the cabin.

• Natural Black Birch Veneer & Ebony Headlining: Elegant interior appointments that reinforce the Range Rover's bespoke luxury character.

This 2025 Land Rover Range Rover SE PHEV is far more than just a luxury SUV, it is the embodiment of the brand's commitment to advanced technology, refined craftsmanship, and unparalleled capability. Available at Land Rover Riverside, this vehicle offers an invitation to experience a flagship luxury SUV that continues to set the benchmark for sophistication and performance.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

This includes a complimentary car wash and vacuum with every service. Prior to your service, contact our dealership team to get your service appointment set up. Financing a vehicle purchase can be a stressful process but Bob Moore INFINITI offers a seamless auto financing, with over 20 lenders to work with. This helps us ensure that we’re getting you the best deal possible for your new car. If you have any questions when going through the financing, don’t stress. We’ll have our INFINITI finance expert there with you to answer any questions or concerns you might have. Do you need to trade in your current vehicle? We buy cars too. Whether it’s a trade-in for a new purchase or just simply selling your vehicle, we’d love to work with you.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
      Safety and Security
      • Hands-on cruise control with lane change - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control with lane change, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up, and helps you make lane changes. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, hands-on cruise control with lane change.
      • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
      • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
      Technology and Telematics
      • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

To keep the peace on long road trips, the automatic temperature control features front dual-zone air conditioning along with separate rear air conditioning so nobody in the back is ever too hot or too cold. Getting inside and starting your day is also simple with remote keyless entry, a welcoming illuminated entry system, and a handy remote start system.Staying connected and entertained on the move is completely effortless for the entire family. This model also includes color-keyed carpeting, matching floor mats, a floor console with a storage area, and a secure anti-theft security system.Safety and heavy-duty towing capability wrap up this incredible SUV package. It comes fully prepared for big hauls thanks to the Max Trailering Package and Advanced Trailering Package, which feature an integrated trailer brake controller, a 2-speed active electronic AutoTrac transfer case, and an extra capacity cooling system. A premium smooth ride suspension keeps the journey comfortable, while the Driver Alert Package looks out for you with Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert and Rear Cross Traffic Alert. Backed by electronic stability control, speed-sensing steering, advanced airbags, and OnStar and Chevrolet connected services capability, this Tahoe is ready for any adventure.Faster. Simpler.
